lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Peyton Pang is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Peyton is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Peyton Pang is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Peyton kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Peyton's gone." Finn looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Peyton." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Connor blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 1). You know where the important bits are. Arteries, joints, organs. Useful for healing or hurting.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Peyton Pang, 41 days. The mantle passes to Connor Brooks.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Connor Brooks, 35 — an ER nurse. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Purify, Green Thumb, Literally, Berserker Rage.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Peyton — and Peyton is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Finn, Minoru, Thabo and 1 more speak for Connor — "Peyton trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Connor before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
